value.os: Mac OS X 10.3 Panther (Power Mac G4 mac99)
value.kbd_note: Aqua desktop: the Dock and the Finder menu bar are the cheapest visible key/click proofs; Terminal gives a real Unix shell one click away.
value.note: TRUE ABSOLUTE pointer via -device usb-tablet (cursor_scale 1.0, offset 0,0), MEASURED on the installed Aqua desktop: a five-target sweep to (120,120), (900,140), (512,384), (140,640) and (900,660) put the arrow sprite's origin on exactly those pixels, error 0 px at every target (cursor-locate.py exact match). Clicks, a System Preferences slider drag and a drag-and-drop into the Dock all landed where aimed. Keyboard: the built-in via=pmu USB board types and takes Cmd-Q / Cmd-A / Shift-Cmd-U.

labctl.notes: Mac OS X 10.3 Panther under TCG on mac99. NO NIC by operator scope. Absolute pointer via usb-tablet. Reset is loadvm golden; warm system_reset is not trusted on -M mac99 (see macos9).

launcherParity.reason: the tracked verbatim launcher IS the deployed launcher; the golden was baked 2026-09-20 with this exact device set on the standalone /opt/qemu-ppc build carrying the cpu/tb_env vmstate patch — a pre-patch binary resumes a PowerPC checkpoint with the timebase jumped forward, so any binary change means a cold re-bake

reset.fixture: Quiet Mac OS X 10.3 Panther Aqua desktop at 1024x768 (Power Mac G4 mac99 under TCG, 1024 MB): one brushed-metal Finder window open on the 'visitor' home folder in icon view (Desktop, Documents, Library, Movies, Music, Pictures, Public, Send Registration, Sites), Macintosh HD on the desktop top-right, the Dock along the bottom with Terminal added to it, nothing selected, no sheet or dialog, cursor parked dead-centre (512,384). Setup Assistant completed and gone (account 'Visitor'/'visitor', no password, registration skipped). Energy Saver pinned to Never with display sleep and disk sleep both off, and the screen saver delay dragged to Never, so the exhibit never blanks itself. Baked 2026-09-20 and restore-proven in a FRESH QEMU process: the guest's own menu-bar clock advanced across 70 s and pointer motion was consumed to two new targets afterwards.

spa.eraLabel: 2003 · Mac OS X 10.3 Panther — Power Mac G4

museum.blurb: Aqua arrives: Apple’s NeXT-derived Unix foundation becomes the Macintosh, with protected memory, the Dock and a rebuilt Finder on the same PowerPC machine as the classic Mac OS it replaced.
museum.notes: Mac OS X 10.3 Panther on QEMU mac99 under TCG, on the same emulated Power Mac G4 as the macos9 exhibit. 10.2 Jaguar was the first target and panics on this machine inside IOSCSIMultimediaCommandsDevice/IODVDStorageFamily (its ATAPI CD stack cannot drive the emulated optical device) — do not switch back. Unlike macos9 this guest drives QEMU's usb-tablet natively, so the pointer is truly absolute at unity scale. Installed from disc 1 alone, customised down to Essential System Software + BSD Subsystem (1.1 GB, which is also what removes the installer's demand for disc 2). No networking, deliberately.

emulator.source: github.com/Wnt/qemu @ kernel-hive (11.0.2 + fast-poll + cpu/tb_env vmstate), built to /opt/qemu-ppc

network.note: NO NIC AT ALL (-nic none, which suppresses QEMU's default user-mode sungem on mac99). Operator scope for this add: ordinary station first — no retronet, no networking. The guest's TCP/IP and AppleTalk control panels were never configured. The golden is baked with this device set; adding a NIC later means a cold re-bake (chokanji/macos753 pattern).

notes: LIVE 2026-09-20. Panther installed from disc 1 with a customised 1.1 GB package set; golden baked and restore-proven in a fresh process. The install wall — the installer refuses a freshly partitioned volume until QEMU is RESTARTED — is documented in docs/lab/MACOSX-WAVE.md.
